Name: Coffee to Hot Cocoa - Reskin
Author: FarmerBriar
Description:
Love hot chocolate more than coffee? This mod will bring your favorite warm drink to Stardew Valley. To complement[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29043] Coffee to Hot Cocoa - Rename[/url], this mod retextures coffee items to look more like hot cocoa!


[size=3][b]CHANGES:[/b][/size]
This mod retextures the following items in the game:
[list]
[*]Coffee → Hot Cocoa
[*]Coffee Bean → Cocoa Bean
[*]Triple Shot Espresso → Large Hot Cocoa
[*]Coffee Maker → Hot Cocoa Maker
[/list][list]
[/list]

[size=3][b]Compatibility:[/b][/size]
This mod is compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5394]Better Artisan Goods[/url] by cometkins as long as the coffee item is unchecked in the config menu. I haven't tested it with other coffee mods.


[size=3][b]Credit:[/b]
[/size]The hot cocoa maker is a retexture I adapted from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8314]Lovely Coffee Maker (CP) [/url]by [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/78133068-lululovely/]lululovely[/url] with permission


[size=3][b]Note:[/b]
[/size]This mod only retextures the coffee items, the names remain the same. If you want to rename all coffee items to hot cocoa, see [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29043] Coffee to Hot Cocoa - Rename[/url]

Manifest.Name: (CP)CoffeetoCocoaReskin
Manifest.Description: Changes all coffee to hot cocoa.
